title: Interest rates
summary: This is a data portal page from the Bank of Canada providing links to various interest rate data including current rates, yield curves, money market yields, and historical comparisons. The page describes what data is available but does not contain any specific policy decisions, rate announcements, or substantive research content itself.
key_points: The Bank of Canada publishes current interest rates with supporting data available in XML, JSON, and CSV formats.
Data offerings include Treasury bill yields, bond yields, Canadian Overnight Repo Rate Average (CORRA), yield curves for zero-coupon bonds, and money market yields.
A lookup tool allows side-by-side comparisons of changes to the Bank Rate and target for the overnight rate over time.
The Bank conducts monetary policy by adjusting the target for the overnight rate on eight fixed dates each year.
No specific rate decision, policy statement, or research finding is contained in this page.
why_it_matters: This page serves as an access point to Bank of Canada interest rate data rather than a substantive research or policy document. It has no direct market impact as it contains no new information or policy decisions.
